     ```kotlin
     @Service
     class ProductIndexApplicationService(
         private val productIndexRepository: ProductIndexRepository,
         private val productAssembleService: ProductAssembleService,
     ) {
         fun indexProducts(changedData: List<ChangedData<ChangedProductDocument>>): IndexResult {
             val indexDocuments = changedData
                 .let(ProductMergeStrategy::merge)
                 .let { productAssembleService.assemble(it) }
                 .filter(ProductEvaluator::evaluate)
             return productIndexRepository.bulk(indexDocuments)
         }
     }
     ```

     ```kotlin
         private val productIndexApplicationService: ProductIndexApplicationService,
         groupId: String,
         consumerCallbackManager: ConsumerCallbackManager,
     ) : FlinkCdcBatchListener(groupId, consumerCallbackManager),
         BatchAcknowledgingConsumerAwareMessageListener<SpecificRecord, SpecificRecord> {
         override fun onMessage(data, acknowledgment, consumer) {
             runCatching {
                 val changedDocuments = data.filter { ... }.map { it.toChangedProductData() }
                 val result = productIndexApplicationService.indexProducts(changedDocuments)
                 logger.info { "Result of indexing: ..." }
             }.onSuccess { acknowledgment?.acknowledge(); rewindIfNeeded() }
              .onFailure { ex -> logger.error(ex) { "Failed to index products" } }
              .getOrThrow()
         }
     }
     ```
